# KaizenEvol

> KaizenEvol is the growth agency for UK local trades and service businesses. Three services, used on their own or stacked: KaizenReach brings the work in, KaizenDesk makes sure none of it slips through, and KaizenForge gives you a website that sells. Run by two founders, Rahaid and Diego, who do the work directly.

## Services

- [KaizenReach](https://kaizenevol.com/kaizenreach.html): Done-for-you Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads plus fully-managed organic social, built only for UK home renovation specialists — kitchen, bathroom and loft. One specialist per niche per area (exclusive territory), campaigns live in 7 days, and clients own their ad account and leads.
- [KaizenDesk](https://kaizenevol.com/kaizendesk.html): An AI front office for any local business. It answers every call, text and email 24/7, qualifies the enquiry, books the job, collects Google reviews and revives cold leads. UK-based and GDPR-compliant; the client keeps their own phone number.
- [KaizenForge](https://kaizenevol.com/kaizenforge.html): Conversion-first websites for local businesses. Live within 24 hours of approval, from £499 one-off, and you own the site outright — you don't pay until you approve it.

## Niche pages (KaizenReach)

- [Kitchen fitters](https://kaizenevol.com/kitchen.html): Meta ads for UK kitchen fitters and remodellers.
- [Bathroom fitters](https://kaizenevol.com/bathroom.html): Meta ads for UK bathroom and wetroom fitters.
- [Loft conversions](https://kaizenevol.com/loft.html): Meta ads for UK loft conversion specialists.
